exp.desc:
- Accessible rebuild of an application portal
- Design system with 60 components
- Testing, code review, mentoring

cl.p1: a form that cannot be used with a screen reader shuts people out. I read that sentence in an audit three years ago, and every project since has been shaped by it. On my last project we rebuilt an application portal to meet accessibility standards and made it load faster at the same time.
cl.p2: I have built frontends in TypeScript for seven years, most recently with a component framework and our own design system. I write tests, review code and explain to designers why a 3:1 contrast ratio is not enough. Your work for public services matches what I care about.

cl.p1: as a graphic designer I handed designs to developers for years and wondered why half of them looked different in the browser. A year ago I started building them myself and completed a web development course.
cl.p2: My final project is a recipe app with search, favourites and offline mode, tested and deployed. I bring a good eye for typography, spacing and detail, and I would like to learn how larger projects are structured as a junior in your team.
